hypothesis: Initial Copper request/first-word spacing, rather than the second COPJMP, causes the remaining RAM fetch differences.
competitor: Inherited Copper state or CPU recognition causes the discrepancy; explicit disabled restart changes its pattern.
test: 192 cases: ROM/RAM execution, inherited/explicit disabled restart, off/WAIT/short active stream, both phases,pad0..3, repeats. Replace measured second COPJMP with NOOP; active first MOVE raises COPER then parks. Compare first RGA read, early IRQ, post-read beam, settled activity.

outcomes.only inherited state differs: Investigate retained Copper word/restart state, not universal COPEN delay.
outcomes.both states differ identically: Constrain request/first-memory timing independent of prior state.
outcomes.ROM/RAM differ: Separate CPU fetch ownership from source forwarding.
